text:
maria: Quick heads-up — noticed an uptick in regression alerts tied to the new 8-bit quant profile on small-seq workloads. Anyone else seeing this? (staging)

aj: I saw 3 alerts this morning. Looks like latency jitter and a token-drop regression on rerank tests.

devon: Can you paste the failing log snippet?

maria: here's the CI snippet:
```
[2026-03-17 09:12:03] rerank_test: token_mismatch at step 42
kernel: fused_attention_v2: fallback path
payload: seq_len=64, batch=8, quant=8bit
```

ci-bot: Build #4821 — 2 tests failed: rerank_test, embedding_stability. See https://ci.redwood/test/4821 :rotating_light:

sophie: tagging @andre for kernel/fallback reasoning. @maria which model variant? small-llama-q8 or rlhf-q8?

maria: small-llama-q8 on dedicated-sim. Repro is flaky locally; only 1/5 runs fail.

andre: I'll take a look. My first guess is the kernel selector chose the fallback NVX implementation under certain sequence lengths. Will instrument with extra traces. Assigning to me.

aj: Can we mark a temporary rollout hold on that quant profile until we root cause? I can flip the rollout flag if we agree.

devon: +1 for hold. Also suggest adding a smoke that runs rerank_test under seq variance to catch this early.

sophie: I can add the smoke to the preflight job — low-cost quick check.

maria: action items: (1) @andre root cause + traces, (2) @sophie add smoke, (3) @aj pause rollout, (4) @devon add rerank stress job. We'll reconvene async. thx :thumbsup:

andre: started a debug branch and added trace points, PR #5578. I'll post logs shortly.

ci-bot: PR #5578 — travis job queued.

maria: ping when you have a short summary; I'll update the delivery board (kanban) and notify support if needed.

andre: summary: initial traces show fallback on fused_attention_v2 when seq_len mod 16 != 0. Suspect padding logic in batcher causing misalignment with kernel assumption. Will push patch.

sophie: smoke added: preflight/quant-small-seq. Enabled on staging.

aj: rollout hold applied to small-llama-q8 in prod config at 09:18 UTC.

maria: thanks everyone. reopening if more regressions. closing for now.
